description: Fake Mumbai Cyber Crime inspector, Hinglish, dictates a UPI ID and the victim types it in PhonePe. Hard override to tier 3.

events.text: Hello, main Inspector Sharma bol raha hoon Mumbai Cyber Crime Branch se. Aapke naam se ek parcel pakda gaya hai jisme drugs hain.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Aapke Aadhaar card par money laundering ka case darj hua hai. Aapko digital arrest kiya ja raha hai. Aap giraftaar ho sakte hain.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Call mat kaatna aur kisi ko mat batana. Abhi turant verification ke liye paise transfer karne honge.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Pachaas hazaar rupaye is account mein bhejo verify dot pay at oksbi
events.speaker: caller
